correctness.rationale: The irreducibility of Φ_p over Q(ζ_(2^s)) forces all coefficients grouped by quadratic phase level to agree. A support smaller than p leaves an empty level, forcing exact cancellation on every occupied fiber. Only reflected pairs allow this, at one unique center. Φ_(2^s)=T^(q/2)+1 gives the exact origin-zero occupancy condition and multinomial count, and unique reflection centers count supports without duplicates. An exact integer cyclotomic-quotient check evaluated 1,528,052 Fourier coefficients across 45,188 assignments; it supplements the all-parameter proof.

value.rationale: A natural finite-alphabet version of the sharp 2026 finite-parabola zero problem has exactly three zero geometries, with all-prime, all-bit-depth, per-support and global phase assignment counts. This removes all isolated off-origin cancellations for quantized odd-prime-disjoint phases and separates zero-free, origin-only and entire-line signal configurations. The complete classification and enumeration are useful at the exact-zero boundary of finite Fourier/MUB sampling; they are more than a numerical special case.
